issue.title: [ML] Anomaly detection jobs should allow missing values for geo fields

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Allows geo fields (`geo_point`, `geo_shape`) to have missing values.
Fixes a bug where such missing values would result in an error.

Closes #57299
